description: Official lottery results as JSON, no API key: Powerball (since 2010), Mega Millions (since 2002), Millionaire for Life (new 2026 game), Cash4Life and New York games (Lotto, Take 5, Numbers, Win 4, Pick 10, Quick Draw). Latest drawing, one date, full history, check your ticket (matches, tier, prize), hot/cold number frequency. Source: New York State Gaming Commission open data. Monitor mode returns only new drawings. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.02 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/lottery-results-api.

bonus.description: For mode check: your Powerball, Mega Ball, Millionaire Ball or Cash Ball number. Leave empty for games without a bonus ball.

date.description: For mode date, or the drawing to check in mode check: YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-14. Empty in check mode = the latest drawing.

drawTime.description: Take 5, Numbers and Win 4 draw twice a day. Empty = both drawings.

draws.description: For mode frequency: count the last N drawings instead of a date range, for example 100.

endDate.description: For history, frequency and range checks: last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the game's latest drawing.

game.description: Which lottery game: powerball (since 2010), megamillions (since 2002) and millionaireforlife (since 2026) are multi-state games; nylotto, take5, numbers, win4, pick10, quickdraw are New York State games; cash4life is retired (history 2014-2

limit.description: Maximum rows returned, newest first. Between 1 and 5000.

mode.description: latest = newest drawing (Quick Draw: newest 10); date = drawings on one day (no drawing that day returns the nearest earlier one with a note); history = every drawing between Start and End date, newest first; check = compare your numbers wi

multiplier.description: For Mega Millions checks since 2025-04-08: the multiplier printed on your ticket (2, 3, 4, 5 or 10), so non-jackpot prizes are returned in USD. Without it you get the base prize and the min-max range.

numbers.description: For mode check: your main numbers separated by spaces or commas, for example 10 22 33 49 57. Digit games (Numbers, Win 4): the digits in order, for example 0863.

startDate.description: For history, frequency and range checks: first day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 90 days back (history) or 365 days back (frequency).
